title: 第026章 妙音愈伤济众徒，残躯守土揽风霜
content_zh:
“你若是敢动她，我相信，华天宗会渣都不剩的。”孟于轩阴沉着脸。

    听说浣花溪涨了大水，雪芙高兴，这一定是建哥哥的功劳，他弄出的雪崩化为春水滋润大地江河了。

    “若是不能交好，就要扼杀在萌芽。”巴赫和巴鼠对视了一眼，彼此瞬间明白了对方的心意。

    彩蝶就是看准了她的善良，才敢理直气壮的“骑到”她的脖子上。

    昏迷中的王建，一个机灵，突然就醒来。听见孩子啼哭，他眨巴眼，没顾上理他。俊眼搜寻，立刻看见了停灵在床上的雪芙了。

    她一拐一拐走出去，钻进自己的房间，门“啪！”地一声关上了。

    以陈玄现在的修为，就算是实力再过强大的绝尘龙军虎，也能够被他轻易的斩杀。

    那个时候，若是祭出凶兽之身或者真灵之身，甚至能够获得远古凶兽或者真灵的天赋神通，从而击杀对手。

    虽然一直被魔域三大王族压制，不过在五千年前，魔煞一族还是出了一位旷世奇才。龙昊天曾与这位奇才恶战了整整一年，最后惺惺相惜，便以各自拿手的绝技互赠。

    “好的，谢谢。”简惜颜拿着单子去做各项检查，来来回回的跑了几趟，才把所有的项目都检查完，然后一脸忐忑的将那些单据交给医生，等待医生的宣判。

    那道能量波就擦这徐帆的身体进过，徐帆勉强躲过这一招但是也被擦出伤口，退后了一步。

    “这样不是办法，我们必须把后面的尾巴甩掉才行，招财你有什么办法吗？”赵世希一边跑一边对着身边的招财轻声问道。
content_en:
"If you dare to touch her, I believe there will be no scum left in the Huatian Sect." Meng Yuxuan said with a sullen face.

    Xue Fu was happy when she heard that the water in Huanhua Creek had surged. This must be due to her brother Jian. The avalanches he caused turned into spring water and nourished the rivers on the earth.

    "If we can't make good friends, we have to nip it in the bud." Bach and Ba Shu looked at each other, and they instantly understood each other's intentions.

    It was because Cai Die saw her kindness that she dared to "ride" on her neck confidently.

    Wang Jian, who was in a coma, suddenly woke up due to a clever move. Hearing the child cry, he blinked and ignored him. Searching with handsome eyes, he immediately saw Xue Fu lying on the bed.

    She limped out and got into her room, and the door closed with a bang.

    With Chen Xuan's current cultivation level, even the more powerful Juechen Longjunhu could be easily killed by him.

    At that time, if you sacrifice the body of a ferocious beast or a true spirit, you can even obtain the innate magical powers of the ancient ferocious beast or true spirit, thereby killing your opponent.

    Although they have been suppressed by the three major royal families of the Demon Realm, five thousand years ago, the Demon Demon Clan still produced a unique genius. Long Haotian fought fiercely with this prodigy for a whole year, and finally they came to understand each other and exchanged their special skills with each other.

    "Okay, thank you." Jian Xiyan took the list for various examinations and ran back and forth several times before checking all the items. Then she handed the documents to the doctor with an anxious look on her face and waited for the doctor's verdict.

    The energy wave passed through Xu Fan's body. Xu Fan barely dodged the move but was scratched and took a step back.

    "This is not the solution. We have to get rid of the tail behind. What can you do about Zhaocai?" Zhao Shixi asked softly to Zhaocai beside him as he ran.
title_en: Chapter 026 The wonderful sound heals the wounds and helps all the disciples, while the remaining body stays in the earth and weathers the wind and frost.
